label: I–II q.1 a.2 co. and ad 1 — Agents act for an end
locator: I–II q.1 a.2 co. and ad 1
interpretation: The body argues that an agent must be determined to a definite effect. Rational agents can direct themselves. Ad 1 allows a human acting at another’s command or under another’s impulsion to be directed to an end without knowing that end.
attribution: The passage states that every agent acts for an end, that a rational agent can direct itself to an end, and that a rational agent acting under another’s direction need not know that end, which is the premise.
